findings.description: The KMS key does not set enable_key_rotation = true, so automatic annual key rotation is disabled by default, leaving the same key material in use indefinitely and increasing the impact of a key compromise.

findings.issue_category: missing key policy / default full access
findings.description: No key_policy is defined for the KMS key, so AWS applies the default key policy granting the root account (and thus any IAM principal with appropriate IAM permissions) full access (kms:*) to the key, which can violate least privilege for a sensitive audit trail encryption key.
